Subject: CAIQ request for private deployment – evidence & mapping

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Sirius is moving into a security review ahead of a procurement decision for Private deployment (VPC + on-prem connectors). Our security team asked for a CAIQ (CSA) mapping of Redwood controls plus samples of evidence we can use in our assessment. Key asks: 

- A completed CAIQ spreadsheet mapping Redwood answers to CSA control IDs (we want to map to our internal gap tracker).
- Evidence for KMS/HSM usage, key rotation policy, and key custody (for private + on-prem).
- Runtime telemetry samples (redaction & retention) and sample logs showing tenant separation and KV cache isolation.
- Confirmation of encryption in transit and at rest for both hosted and private connectivity patterns.
- Any SOC2/ISO references that align with the mapped controls.

Can you confirm scope and provide an intake list of what Redwood needs from us? We’d ideally have the initial mapping and evidence pointers by Aug 20 for our security review. I’ve attached a one-page request outline.

Attachment: Sirius_CA_Request.pdf

Best,
Emma Gallagher
Sr. InfoSec Manager – Sirius Therapeutics

Hi Emma / Sirius team —

Thanks for the request and the call earlier this week. We’ve put together an initial CAIQ deliverable and an intake checklist so your security reviewers can begin validation. Attached: redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (mapping + evidence index). I’ve also staged sample artifacts in the Drive folder linked below (sanitized logs and policy documents).

High-level summary:
- Encryption & KMS/HSM: Redwood Private uses customer-managed KMS options for Private deployments (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM-backed providers). Attached evidence: key-rotation-policy.pdf, kms-integration-design.pdf. Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Runtime telemetry & tenant isolation: runtime-keystore-logs-sample.txt (sanitized) demonstrates per-tenant cache separation, prefix isolation, and request traces. Retention: configurable, default 90 days for telemetry; production retention options documented in telemetry-retention.md. Owner: Jordan Blake.
- Network encryption: mTLS for inter-service comms, TLS 1.3 for external endpoints. Configuration examples included.
- SOC2 alignment: we included pointers to our SOC2 report sections that map to the CSA IDs in the spreadsheet.

What we need from Sirius to complete a full submission:
- Confirmation on scope (VPC-only vs VPC + on-prem connectors with bi-directional tunnels).
- Network diagrams showing any on-prem connectors or customer key escrow locations.
- If you want HSM attestation, which vendor (if using customer HSM) so we can produce vendor-specific guidance.

Drive folder (read-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-sirius-caiq
Attached files: redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx, runtime-keystore-logs-sample.txt, key-rotation-policy.pdf
